label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 152 ]

blocks.text: A child will often ask for approval openly. "Look at my painting! Isn't it pretty?" But adults are generally less honest about their need for support. A grown-up who tried his or her best at something isn't like to ask, "Didn't I do a good job!" But the adult needs to hear it all the same. In other words, children and adults alike want to hear positive remarks. Therefore, don't forget to praise others when they need support.

readingSentences.english: Curiosity is the engine of intellectual growth and scientific discovery.
readingSentences.korean: 호기심은 지적 성장과 과학적 발견의 강력한 원동력이다.

readingSentences.english: Children are naturally inquisitive, constantly asking why things are the way they are.
readingSentences.korean: 어린이들은 태생적으로 호기심이 많아서 사물이 왜 그러한지 끊임없이 묻는다.

readingSentences.english: Nurturing this wonder into adulthood leads to inventive breakthroughs and lifelong learning.
readingSentences.korean: 성인이 되어서도 이러한 경이로움을 잘 가꾸어 나가는 것은 독창적인 비약과 평생 학습으로 이어진다.

readingSentences.english: A mind that remains curious never grows old.
readingSentences.korean: 늘 호기심을 유지하는 정신은 결코 늙지 않는다.
